title: Pure Endymion
summary: Pure Endymion and its Spell Counter support with generic staples, blending the Pendulum Endymion monsters with the 2026 Regulus and Maid of Endymion wave. Every Spell you activate stacks Spell Counters across your Scales, Field Spell, and Continuous Spells to cheat out Spellcasters from the Deck, Pendulum Zone, and Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Spell Power Mastery searches any Endymion card from the Deck and places Spell Counters equal to the number of Spell Power Mastery and Spell Power Grasp copies you control or have in the GY.

Endymion Empire adds Regulus, the Prince of Endymion (or a monster that mentions it) and can Special Summon a Spellcaster, while Regulus reveals a Spellcaster in hand to Special Summon itself and search a Spell that names it.

Servant of Endymion (Scale 2) accumulates 3 Spell Counters from your Spells and removes them to Special Summon itself alongside any 1000+ ATK monster that can hold a Spell Counter (such as Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic) directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Endymion Empire + Servant of Endymion
steps: Place Magical Citadel of Endymion or Endymion's Lab on the field and set Servant of Endymion in the Pendulum Zone.
Activate Endymion Empire (placing Spell Counters on Servant and Citadel) to search Regulus, the Prince of Endymion; reveal a Spellcaster to Special Summon Regulus and search another Spell.
Special Summon Genni, the Maid of Endymion next to your Spellcaster and banish a Spellcaster to Special Summon Verre, the Maid of Endymion from the Deck, searching Magical Dimension.
Remove 3 Spell Counters from Servant of Endymion to Special Summon both Servant and Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic from the Deck with Spell Counters on them.
Link Summon Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians or overlay two Level 7 monsters into Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon, then link Absolute Dragon away to summon Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon.

summary.title: Spell Counter Engine
summary.text: Magical Citadel of Endymion and Endymion's Lab (which is treated as Magical Citadel of Endymion in the Spell & Trap Zone) collect a Spell Counter every time a Spell Card resolves, and Citadel can remove its own counters in place of any Spellcaster's counter cost. Magister of Endymion (Scale 8) removes 3 counters to summon itself and a face-up monster from the Extra Deck, Reflection of Endymion (Scale 2) summons itself and a monster from the hand while bouncing an opposing card, and Endymion, the Master Magician removes 6 counters from Citadel to Special Summon itself from the hand or GY and recover a Spell.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic negates any Spell or Trap activation once per turn by returning a card you control with a Spell Counter to the hand, is untargetable and indestructible by card effects while it has a Spell Counter, and can remove 6 counters from its Pendulum Zone to Special Summon itself and destroy cards on the field up to the number of cards you control that can hold a Spell Counter.
Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon bounces an opponent's Attack Position monster on Special Summon and shuffles a face-up Pendulum Monster from the Extra Deck into the Deck to negate any card or effect.
Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians gains Spell Counters equal to the total Spells on the field and in the GYs, removing 3 on either turn to revive a Spellcaster in Defense Position.

summary.title: Spells
points: Spell Power Grasp places a Spell Counter on a card and searches another copy of Spell Power Grasp to fuel Spell Power Mastery next turn.

Magical Dimension (searched by Verre, the Maid of Endymion) Tributes a monster while you control a Spellcaster to Special Summon a Spellcaster from the hand and destroy 1 monster on the field without targeting.
Endymion Empire can destroy Regulus, the Prince of Endymion instead when your Spellcaster or Spell Counter card would be destroyed.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Secondary Magistus, Dark Magician, and Witchcrafter engines from the archetype page are omitted to keep the build pure Endymion (though Verre, the Maid of Endymion is inherently treated as a Witchcrafter card by its own text).

allow.Magical Dimension: Generic Spellcaster Spell that Verre, the Maid of Endymion searches.
allow.Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon: Dragon Fusion boss providing bounce removal and omni-negation by shuffling face-up Pendulums.
allow.Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon: Rank 7 Dragon Xyz that floats into Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon upon being sent to the GY.

main: Regulus, the Prince of Endymion
Newest support. Reveals a Spellcaster to summon itself from the hand, then searches a Spell that names it.
Verre, the Maid of Endymion
Newest support. Summons itself after a Spell resolves this turn; searches a Witchcrafter Spell/Trap or Magical Dimension, and gains 2300 ATK with Regulus around.
Genni, the Maid of Endymion
2026 support. Summons itself next to a Spellcaster, and banishes one to summon Verre, which counts as a Witchcrafter, from the Deck.
Endymion, the Mighty Master of Magic
Scale 8: removes six Spell Counters to summon itself and destroy cards; on the field, negates a Spell/Trap by returning a countered card.
Servant of Endymion
Scale 2: removes three counters to summon itself and a 1000+ ATK Spell Counter monster from the Deck.
Magister of Endymion
Scale 8: removes three counters to summon itself and a face-up monster from the Extra Deck.
Reflection of Endymion
Scale 2: removes three counters to summon itself and a monster from the hand; bounces an opposing card when summoned.
Endymion, the Master Magician
Removes six counters from the Citadel to summon itself, then gets a Spell back; discards Spells to destroy cards.
Rogue of Endymion
Removes its counter and discards a Spellcaster to Set a Continuous Spell from the Deck.
Endymion Empire
Newest support. Fetches Regulus or a monster that names it, then can summon a Spellcaster; protects your cards by destroying Regulus instead.
Spell Power Mastery
Searches any Endymion card and places Spell Counters for each Spell Power card you have.
Spell Power Grasp
Places a Spell Counter and searches another Grasp.
Magical Citadel of Endymion
Field Spell that collects a Spell Counter for every Spell and pays counter costs for your cards.
Endymion's Lab
Counts as the Citadel in the Spell & Trap Zone and collects counters too.
Magical Dimension
Tributes a monster to summon a Spellcaster from the hand, then destroys a monster.
extra: Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Link-3 with a Spellcaster: collects Spell Counters on summon, and removes three to summon a Spellcaster from the hand or GY.
Level 7 Fusion: bounces an opponent's Attack Position monster on summon and shuffles a face-up Pendulum to negate any effect.
Rank 7: negates an attack to Special Summon an Odd-Eyes from hand/GY, and Special Summons an Odd-Eyes Fusion/Synchro (Vortex Dragon!) on leaving.
